Automotive UI

Three concepts for how a car could explain itself. Hover the Polestar 5 to light it up and read the spec behind every part, hover the Ford Bronco and it tells you out loud, then talk to the AI Dashboard: an in-car assistant that answers by voice and brings up the setting you ask for.

Ford Bronco · Concept 02

Spec Explorer, audio

Hover the car to hear each part
01 / FRONTLED headlampsTurn sound on to hear thisLED headlamps, with automatic high beams. Round, like the original nineteen sixty-six Bronco.
02 / FRONT2.3L EcoBoost engineTurn sound on to hear thisUnder the bonnet, a two point three litre EcoBoost four-cylinder. Three hundred horsepower, and three hundred and twenty-five pound-feet of torque.
03 / FRONTBuilt squareTurn sound on to hear thisSquare by design. Nearly six feet tall and seventy-five point nine inches wide. It is built to climb, not to cheat the wind.
04 / FRONTGround clearanceTurn sound on to hear thisEight point three inches of ground clearance, with selectable four-wheel drive to put it to work.
01 / SIDERemovable doorsTurn sound on to hear thisThe doors come off. Take them and the top away, for open-air driving.
02 / SIDERemovable hard topTurn sound on to hear thisThe hard top comes off too. Lift out the panels over the front seats, or remove the whole roof.
03 / SIDE4x4 systemTurn sound on to hear thisFour-by-four with part-time selectable engagement, on sixteen-inch steel wheels. An automatic on-demand system is available.
04 / SIDEShort wheelbaseTurn sound on to hear thisA one hundred point four inch wheelbase, and one hundred and seventy-four inches long. Short, so it turns tight on the trail.
01 / REARTail lampsTurn sound on to hear thisTail lamps, and a high-mounted brake light on the swing gate.
02 / REARSwing gateTurn sound on to hear thisThe side-hinged swing gate opens up to fifty-two cubic feet of cargo space.
03 / REARRugged tyresTurn sound on to hear thisThirty-inch all-season tyres on sixteen-inch steel wheels, with a full-size spare on the gate. Thirty-five inch rugged-terrain tyres are available.
04 / REARTowingTurn sound on to hear thisTow up to three thousand five hundred pounds.
01 / INTERIOR12-inch touchscreenTurn sound on to hear thisA twelve-inch touchscreen, running SYNC 4.
02 / INTERIORDigital clusterTurn sound on to hear thisA twelve-inch digital instrument cluster, right behind the wheel.
03 / INTERIORG.O.A.T. modesTurn sound on to hear thisGoat modes. Goes over any type of terrain. Normal, Eco, Sport, Slippery and Sand, on one dial.
04 / INTERIOR7-speed manualTurn sound on to hear thisA seven-speed manual comes standard, with a ten-speed automatic available.

Concept interface, not affiliated with any car manufacturer. Voice works in Chrome, Edge and Safari; speech is recognised by your browser (in Chrome, by Google’s speech service) and the microphone is only live while the button is lit. In other browsers, type or tap a topic.
